messages:
rachael: heads up — onboarding gemmax2 with nf4 quant we saw embedding drift vs fp16 baseline in downstream rerank eval. per-token cos sims drop ~0.07. suspect tokenizer normalization mismatch + quant noise.

samir: can you paste the eval numbers and the tokenizer configs you used?

rachael: eval summary:
- fp16 baseline: recall@20 0.842
- nf4 (default gemma tokenizer): recall@20 0.761
- nf4 + force NFKC normalization: recall@20 0.813
also cos-sim mean per-token: fp16 0.89 -> nf4 0.82

\rachael: reproduction cmd:
```
PYTHONPATH=. python3 tools/run_rerank_eval.py \
  --model checkpoints/gemmax2-fp16 \
  --quant nf4 --tokenizer gemma --norm NFKC \
  --batch 32 --max_len 512
```

kai: hmm, are vocab ids being aliased? we saw gemma vocab includes an extra nonbreaking-space variant. try running tokenizer.tokenize(" ") and compare ids.

samir: also check rotary base/scale — gemma uses rope_scale 1.0 default but this variant might have legacy 0.5 headwise scaling. mismatch would explain sequence drift. dump state_dict['model.layers.0.self_attn.rope_freq']

rachael: did both. token id mismatch: NBSP mapped to different id, causing off-by-one shift in kv cache for some token sequences. fixed by running convert_vocab_aliases.py and forcing `--normalization NFKC`. kerneldump showed rope_scale param diff.

rachael: quick patch we ran:
```
python3 tools/convert_vocab_aliases.py --src vocab/gemma.json --dst vocab/gemma-norm.json --map_nbsp
sed -i 's/rope_scale\": 0.5/rope_scale\": 1.0/' model_config.json
```

samir: can we add a unit test in model-onboard CI? if tokenizer normalization differs from model_config.norm add a failure.

ops-bot: ci/build #4821 triggered by rachael — onboard/gemmax2 quant smoke

rachael: rollout plan: 1) pin tokenizer to gemma-norm in model registry 2) publish conversion tool in onboarding docs 3) add CI check for tokenizer/model mismatch 4) re-run quant sweep (nf4, int8 gptq) and post final metrics

kai: +1. add a short note in release notes: "gemmax2: tokenizer normalization and rope_scale fix; quant nf4 now within 98% of fp16 recall on rerank"

samir: also add a small eval on long-context (2k) for kv cache correctness — token aliasing can affect that more.

rachael: will do. thanks. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: smoke tests passed (3/3).
